newsitem.title: UK: FOCUS-Distillers pitches Tony at 'Girls Nite Out'.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS-Distillers pitches Tony at 'Girls Nite Out'.

text.p: United Distillers, the spirits arm of Guinness Plc, on Wednesday launched a range of ready mixed cocktails called Tony's Freezer Cocktails, the latest in a long line of products aimed at young women.

Research conducted by Britain's drinks and foods industry has highlighted a significant shift in spending patterns with men in decline and women emerging as consumers of mounting importance, as more enter the workforce.
As well as Tony's, Distillers has spawned Moscow Mule, while Allied Domecq Plc has Barking Frog -- a Tequila and lemon mix -- and Kahlua Mudslide.
Most of a recent rash of so-called flavoured alcoholic beverages were launched first to supermarkets in a bid to reach female shoppers browsing for home consumption.
This strategy has been reinforced by longer-term research underlining the decline in importance of men when it comes to stocking the family drinks cabinet.

Studies by brewer Bass Plc showed that the decline in Britain's manufacturing sector and its predominately male workforce have reduced demand for beer and made the customer who aimed to drink his age in pints an increasingly rare creature.
Bass found that 'non-beer' visits to the pub were up 22 percent over two years, while the number of drinkers who put down eight pints of beer per week or more is down 27 percent.
The drinks companies are pinning their hopes on the girls.
Distillers' own research found that women aged 18-35 want a ready-made, single-serve drink and they don't much care for the hassle of making their own.
They hit upon the social phenomenum in Britain of the "Girls' Nite Out" and the brand advertising is being crafted to appeal to the occassion.
"The UK 'girls' night' is characterised by lots of laughter and fun, outrageously silly or relaxed and comfortable," Distillers UK brand development manager Karin Schwartz told reporters.
The drinks will be backed by a 2.0 million pounds ($3.3 million) advertising campaign from July.
The cocktails, packaged in eye-catching chrome-coloured pouches, will be available in three different flavours -- Classic Margarita, Mango Daiquiri and Strawberry Daiquiri. ($ = 0.612 British Pounds)
